SS-SOURCE-GENERATORS.Purpose: Roslyn source generation for Widget and ordinary FVP classes: select supported types independently in each pipeline, analyze declarations and emit reactive partial implementations.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Shared generator entry point and source-building infrastructure — owned by M-SOURCE-GENERATORS-COMMON.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Widget analysis, models and member emission — owned by M-REACTIVITY-ANALYZER, M-WIDGET-MODELS and M-WIDGET-EMITTER.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Ordinary FVP discovery, analysis and emission — owned by M-FLEXVERSE-PROPERTY.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Post-compilation property redirection — owned by SS-IL-WEAVING.

Principles.PRIN-001: Analysis and emission are separate contracts: analyzers produce models and emitters consume them without re-parsing source text.

Requirements.REQ-001: Exactly one pipeline owns each supported type: Widget classes use the Widget pipeline and ordinary FVP classes use the FVP pipeline.
Requirements.REQ-002: Valid input produces compilable generated code; invalid generated code is a generator defect rather than a user diagnostic.
Requirements.REQ-003: Emission is deterministic: identical models produce identical source text.
Requirements.REQ-004: Each source-generator member emitter must be named after the generated code symbol it owns, preserving that symbol's spelling (for example EnsureFvpInitialized, ReleaseFvp, BindRefs). An emitter for a family of reactive properties must instead use the corresponding property-category name (Fvp, Prop, State, InheritedContext) and own the complete property structure, including backing fields, change notifications, getter and setter. Pipeline orchestrators and shared emission helpers are outside this member-emitter naming rule.
Requirements.REQ-005: Each pipeline must own its models, extractors, diagnostics, member emitters and type-selection predicates, without dependencies on the other pipeline. Local duplication is permitted to preserve these boundaries. Shared utilities must contain only pipeline-neutral operations; Widget/FVP selection and behavior contracts remain local to their pipelines.
Requirements.REQ-006: Analysis supplies structured type identity, declaration names and lifecycle ownership decisions to emitters; emission consumes these verdicts without parsing generated C# strings.
